items.author: nabrahams.bsky.social
items.context:
Not only do I remember my first video game, I remember the restaurant I played it in. (It was Lum's in 1980)
image: A standup arcade cabinet of Pac Man.; quotes @sophianyx.bsky.social: Name the first videogame you played.
items.text: Pac-Man in 1980, and you remember the restaurant too. That's a great first one.

items.author: cm30.bsky.social
items.context:
Name the first video game I played? This iconic Game Boy title!
link card: Super Mario Land 2d Platformer; quotes @sophianyx.bsky.social: Name the first videogame you played.
items.text: Super Mario Land is a great first game. Short levels, easy to pick up, and the Game Boy made it feel like a tiny magic box.

items.author: meganpaasch.bsky.social
items.context: Right?? I'm hoping if they take them away, GOG (Good Old Games) will preserve them and make them available on their site. They already have DA: Origins and Jade Empire on there.
items.text: Keeping old games playable is a big part of what GOG does, and since the installers are DRM-free you can also back up your own copy.

items.author: projectazar.com
items.context:
The first I remember is Halloween Harry/Alien Carnage, but I've been playing since at least age 3 so it might be something closer to a whack a mole DOS game.
quotes @sophianyx.bsky.social: Name the first videogame you played.
items.text: Alien Carnage is a proper deep cut. Playing since age three is a serious head start, too.
